title: Polish individual team pages on mobile

criteria.text: Match History team names are readable at 390 and 360: name box wider (was 75.6px at 390), up to 2 lines, logo link no longer forces 44px width
criteria.evidence: QA: name box 91.6px at 390 (was 75.6), 76.6 at 360 (was 60.6), up to 2 lines, 0 overlaps. Shots .factory/evidence/T-261102-polish-individual-team-p/before/ vs .factory/evidence/T-261102-polish-individual-team-p/after/phone-teams-fake-team-bravo-with-a-very-long-name-here.png

criteria.text: Match History logo links are not extra tab stops (aria-hidden + tabIndex -1); the name link stays focusable
criteria.evidence: QA: logo links aria-hidden + tabindex -1; tab order 2 stops per row (was 4); name link shows focus ring

criteria.text: Match History team names meet 4.5:1 contrast in the light theme
criteria.evidence: QA light theme: winner 4.95:1, loser 6.42:1 (was 3.22 / 3.81); dark colours unchanged

criteria.text: Roster chips show names up to about 160px wide without cutting them at 80px (PlayerList only, PlayerChip default unchanged)
criteria.evidence: QA: Fake Player 1A/1B/1C ~82px, not cut (max 160); 192px name cut with title

criteria.text: Career power-score chart: first x label and y-axis title are not clipped at 360 and 390
criteria.evidence: QA: chart first x label 6.6px inside, y title 29px from left, centred, at 360/390; desktop checked

criteria.text: Last match link is at least 44px tall and 'Last match:' does not wrap; Report Card Season/Career toggles are at least 44px tall
criteria.evidence: QA: Last match link 44px tall, one line with long opponent; Season/Career toggles 66.7x44 and 62.8x44; badges still open dialogs

criteria.text: Back button on a direct or shared link goes to /teams instead of leaving the app
criteria.evidence: QA: direct link then Back -> /teams (also after #stats and sticky-nav tap); /stats -> team -> Back -> /stats

criteria.text: Error text has no double period, and 'No Match History' text is hidden when matches failed to load
criteria.evidence: QA: no double period on team-not-found and load errors; matches 500 shows one alert and hides 'No Match History'; matches [] still shows it

criteria.text: No new console errors, no sideways scroll at 360 and 390 on all four team routes, touched components' tests pass
criteria.evidence: All 6 required checks pass at HEAD (typecheck, lint, unit 750s, build, knip, integrity). QA: 0 console errors and no sideways scroll at 360/390 on 4 routes and /stats. Developer ran 27 test files / 207 tests in src/components/teams + TeamDetails.

reviews.summary: Team page polish: components used only by TeamDetails, Back button key handling verified in router source, aria-hidden valid with tabIndex -1, dark: covers winter, mock fake-only with no network calls, 36/36 tests pass.

Re-review at HEAD 5917eef: follow-up commit verified (Recharts reads textAnchor attribute; margin tests 32/6 match component and can fail); only src/components/teams, TeamDetails and the fake-data mock changed since the cf1021d approval; 37/37 touched tests pass.

notes.text: Left alone on purpose: hero logo size 144 vs 112 (look change, needs Doug), hero badges div->button (shared with home/standings cards), sticky nav wrong active pill (logic change, follow-up), shared colours/components (power-score colours, Tabs, Select, site header), global scroll-padding. Human choice earlier: fake-data screenshots.
QA low findings, accepted: names needing 3+ lines are cut at 2 (right-aligned side shows no ellipsis; full name in title); hero ~20px taller because Last match link is now 44px.

Reviewer suggestions, not blocking: put textAnchor:'middle' directly on the chart label object (works today via CSS style); comment that a hand-typed URL also Back->/teams; no unit test for chart margins.
